_comment: Hand-maintained rows. Update 'yield_pct', 'as_of' (date the provider published the number) and 'checked_on' (date a human looked it up) weekly. Never fill in a number you did not read from the source page. affiliate_url stays '#' until the owner has signed up to a programme.

rows.name: Vanguard Federal Money Market (VMFXX)
rows.source_note: Read from the data feed behind Vanguard's own VMFXX profile page (investor.vanguard.com/vmf/api/0033/yields, 'SEC 7-Day Average Income Yield Net Of Expenses', daily, as of 10/26/2026).
rows.risk_note: Government money-market fund. Not FDIC-insured and not a bank deposit; yield moves daily with short-term rates.

rows.name: Fidelity Government Money Market (SPAXX)
rows.source_note: Read from the data feed behind Fidelity's fund research page (yield7dayDaily, as of 10/26/2026).
rows.risk_note: Government money-market fund and the default cash sweep at Fidelity. Not FDIC-insured; yield changes daily.

rows.name: Fidelity Money Market (SPRXX)
rows.source_note: Read from the data feed behind Fidelity's fund research page (yield7dayDaily, as of 10/26/2026).
rows.risk_note: Prime money-market fund: holds some corporate paper, so slightly more credit risk than a government fund. Not FDIC-insured.

rows.name: Schwab Prime Advantage Money Fund (SWVXX)
rows.source_note: Read from Schwab Asset Management fund page (as of 10/26/2026; 3.73% without waivers).
rows.risk_note: Prime money-market fund: holds some corporate paper, so slightly more credit risk than a government fund. Not FDIC-insured.

rows.name: Schwab U.S. Treasury Money Fund (SNSXX)
rows.source_note: Read from Schwab Asset Management fund page (as of 10/26/2026; same with/without waivers).
rows.risk_note: Holds only US Treasuries, so interest is generally state-tax exempt. Still a fund, not a deposit; yield changes daily.

rows.name: Coinbase USDC rewards (Coinbase One)
rows.source_note: Headline rate for paid Coinbase One members (from $4.99/month); rate varies by region and can change monthly. Coinbase Business accounts show 3.60%.
rows.risk_note: Your USDC sits with Coinbase, not in your own wallet. You rely on the company staying solvent; the rate is set by Coinbase and can change. Membership fee reduces the net yield.

rows.name: Kraken USDC rewards (Kraken+)
rows.source_note: 'Up to' rate for Kraken+ subscribers. Available where Kraken serves US, Canada, Australia and UK clients.
rows.risk_note: Your USDC sits with Kraken. Rate is an 'up to' figure, variable, and needs a Kraken+ subscription.

rows.name: Kraken USDC rewards (no subscription)
rows.source_note: 'Up to' rate for non-subscribers. Available where Kraken serves US, Canada, Australia and UK clients.
rows.risk_note: Your USDC sits with Kraken. Rate is an 'up to' figure and can change at any time.
